_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no momentum/funding/fear-greed breaker has fired, so the skilled call is hold the current rung rather than force a two-rung slide to Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst explicit forward is HOLD/Complacency; Narrative only supplies bearish flow color with no forward phase; consensus forces HOLD at Hope per ±1 rung and coil rule
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, 30d momentum holds near 50, funding stays flat, score remains in Hope band (63-70) or one rung adjacent
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum breaks under ~40 with range loss and sustained exchange inflows (slip to Disbelief), or squeeze lifts momentum through ~65 and fear/greed through 70 (step to Optimism)
